description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application targeting Wear OS. It manages UI layout inflation, animations on click events, gesture detection, and dismissal overlay handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling layout setup, animations, gesture detection, and overlay interaction on an Android Wear OS device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets up gesture detection and layout inflation listener.

methods.name: onLayoutClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on the layout, triggering scale and rotation animations depending on the layout type.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides touch event dispatching to include gesture detection.

methods.name: LongPressListener.onLongPress
methods.description: Inner class method invoked on long press gesture to show dismiss overlay.
